book.name: Yoohana
book.title: Amangʼana Amazʉmu ga Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ chɨmbu gaandikirwɨ na Yoohana

content: Yɨɨsu newe ɨnzɨra yu ukuja kwa Mungu
Yɨɨsu akangʼeha kwija abhɨɨga bhaazɨ arabhuga, “Mʉtarumɨka mozekoro zaanyu, mwisiriryɨ Mungu, munyiisiriryɨ na niinyɨ.
Mumujɨ gwa Bhaabha hu ukwikara nɨ‑haaru. Angabhɨɨrɨ ɨtarɨbhu, naarɨ nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra. Nangʉ nɨraja kʉbhakonzera ahagero.
Hanʉ nɨkʉmara kʉbhakonzera, nɨraaza naatu kʉbhagega korereke ahagero hanʉ nɨkʉbha, na niimwɨ mʉbhɨhʉ.
Imwɨ mwɨzɨ ɨnzɨra yu ukuhika hanʉ nikuja.”
Neho Tomaaso akabhuga, “Ʉmʉkʉrʉ, tʉtɨɨzɨ hanʉ ukuja. Nangʉ, tʉratʉrabhwɨ komenya ɨnzɨra?”
Yɨɨsu akamʉbhʉʉrɨra, “Inyɨ niinyɨ ɨnzɨra, amaheene nʉ ʉbhʉhʉru. Atareeho wʉnʉ akʉtʉra kuuza kwa Bhaabha arɨɨbhɨ akɨɨrɨ kʉhɨtɨra kwa niinyɨ.
Mwangamɨnyirɨ inyɨ, mwarɨ mʉramenya na Bhaabha. Kwɨma nangwɨnʉ, mumwɨzɨ na mʉmʉrʉʉzɨ.”
Firipʉ akamʉbhʉʉrɨra, “Ʉmʉkʉrʉ, tʉrakʉsabha utwereche Bhaabha, riyo iryene ririisa.”
Yɨɨsu akamʉgarukirya, “Firipʉ, nɨbhɨɨrɨ hamwɨmwɨ na niimwɨ ibhaga rɨnʉ ryʉsi, ʉkɨɨrɨ komenya? Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ andʉʉzɨ inyɨ, amʉrʉʉzɨ Bhaabha. Kwakɨ ʉrambuurya, ‘Twereche Bhaabha?’
Nangʉ, ʉtakwisirirya inyɨ nɨrɨ kwa Bhaabha, na Bhaabha arɨ kwa niinyɨ? Amangʼana ganʉ nɨkʉbhabhʉʉrɨra gatakurwa mumiisɨɨgi gaanɨ, nawe Bhaabha wʉnʉ arɨ kwa niinyɨ, arakora emeremo jazɨ.
Mwisiriryɨ ganʉ nɨkʉgamba kʉbha, nɨrɨ kwa Bhaabha, neewe arɨ kwa niinyɨ. Nawe arɨɨbhɨ mʉtakwisirirya gayo, ambe mwisiriryɨ igʉrʉ we emeremo gɨnʉ nekokora.
Nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra amaheene, ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ akunyiisirirya, arakora emeremo gɨnʉ inyɨ nekokora. Na arakora mɨkʉrʉ kʉkɨra gɨnʉ nekokora, kʉ kʉbha inyɨ nɨraja kwa Bhaabha.
Hanʉ mʉkʉsabha chʉchʉsi kuriina ryanɨ, inyɨ nɨrakora, korereke kʉhɨtɨra Umwana ukugungibhwa kwa Bhaabha kororekanɨ.
Na mʉransabhɨ ekegero chʉchʉsi kuriina ryanɨ, nɨrakora.
Yɨɨsu aragambɨra ukuuza kwe Ekoro Ɨndɨndu
“Arɨɨbhɨ mʉnsɨɨgirɨ, mʉragwata amaswaja gaanɨ.
Mmbe, na niinyɨ nɨrasabha Bhaabha abhahɨ Ʉmʉsakirya ʉwʉndɨ,
korereke abhɨ na niimwɨ kemerano.

Ewe newe Ekoro ya Amaheene. Abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhakwanga Mungu bhatakʉtʉra kʉyɨsʉngʼaana, kʉ kʉbha bhatakoyerora, na bhatayɨɨzɨ. Nawe imwɨ muyɨɨzɨ Ekoro yiyo, kʉ kʉbha iriikara kwa niimwɨ, na ɨrabha kwa niimwɨ.
“Nɨtakʉbhatiga imubheene ncha abhahabhɨ, naatu nɨragarʉka kwa niimwɨ.
Rɨkɨɨrɨ ibhaga isuuhu ɨɨsɨ ɨtakondora. Nawe imwɨ mʉrandora, na kʉ kʉbha inyɨ mʉhʉru, na niimwɨ mʉrabha bhahʉru.
Urusikʉ ruyo, mʉramenya kʉbha inyɨ nɨrɨ kwa Bhaabha, na niimwɨ mʉrɨ kwa niinyɨ, na niinyɨ nɨrɨ kwa niimwɨ.
Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ ɨɨzɨ amaswaja gaanɨ na kʉgagwata, wuyo newe ansɨɨgirɨ. Nʉ ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ ansɨɨgirɨ, Bhaabha aramʉsɨɨga. Na niinyɨ nɨramʉsɨɨga na kwiyeerecha kwawɨ.”
Mmbe, umwɨga wʉmwɨ iriina ryazɨ Yuuda, atarɨ Yuuda Isikariyʉʉti, akabhuurya Yɨɨsu, “Ʉmʉkʉrʉ, ɨratʉrɨkanabhwɨ oreenda kwiyeerekanʼya kwa niitwɨ, nawe ʉtakwiyeerekanʼya kʉʉsɨ?”
Yɨɨsu akamʉgarukirya, “Ʉmʉʉtʉ aransɨɨgɨ, aragwata amangʼana gaanɨ, na Bhaabha aramʉsɨɨga. Inyɨ na Bhaabha tʉraaza kwawɨ na kwikara hamwɨmwɨ nawe.
Nawe ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ atansɨɨgirɨ, atakugwata amangʼana gaanɨ. Na ganʉ mukwigwa gatarɨ gaanɨ, nawe gararwa kwa Bhaabha wʉnʉ antumirɨ.
“Nɨbhabhuuriirɨ gʉʉsi gayo nɨkɨɨrɨ hamwɨmwɨ na niimwɨ.
Nawe Ʉmʉsakirya wuyo, newe Ekoro Ɨndɨndu, Bhaabha aramʉtʉma kwa niimwɨ kuriina ryanɨ, arabhiija na kʉbhahiitya gʉʉsi ganʉ naarɨ nɨbhabhuuriirɨ.
Hanʉ nɨkʉbhʉʉka, nɨrabhatigɨra omorembe, omorembe gwanɨ nɨrabhaha. Nawe gʉnʉ nɨkʉbhaha gʉtangɨ gʉnʉ abhaatʉ bhahaabhaha. Mutiitiimaata mozekoro zaanyu, na mʉtʉʉbhaha.
Mwigwirɨ ganʉ nabhabhuuriirɨ, ‘Nɨraja, akʉmara nɨragarʉka naatu kwa niimwɨ.’ Angabhɨɨrɨ mʉnsɨɨgirɨ, mwarɨ mʉrazomerwa kwigwa nɨraja kwa Bhaabha, kʉ kʉbha Bhaabha nɨ‑mʉkʉrʉ kʉkɨra inyɨ.
Nɨbhabhuuriirɨ amangʼana gayo, gakɨɨrɨ kororekana, korereke hanʉ gakororekana mʉtʉrɨ kunyiisirirya.
“Nɨtakʉtʉra kʉgamba na niimwɨ ibhaga irɨɨhu, kʉ kʉbha ʉmʉkʉrʉ wɨ ɨɨsɨ yɨnʉ araaza. Nawe ataana ʉbhʉnaja igʉrʉ waanɨ.
Ganʉ nekokora nɨ‑ganʉ Bhaabha answajiryɨ kokora, korereke abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi bhamenye kʉbha nɨmʉsɨɨgirɨ. “Nangʉ, mʉbhʉʉkɨ tujɨ.”

footnotes.text: Ʉmʉsakirya ʉwʉndɨ, enzobhooro yaku ne‑Koro Ɨndɨndu.
